info.name: Hubilo (Virtual PRO) Public Event User API

description.content:
Hubilo Public APIs (branded Virtual PRO) for managing virtual, hybrid, and in-person events: events, sessions/agenda, speakers, users/attendees, member groups, exhibitor booths, organiser profile, and media upload. Derived faithfully from the provider's published Postman collection (Virtual Pro Public APIs v1.2). Rate limit: 20 requests/second at the organizer level (combined across all APIs).

Contact Support:
 Name: Hubilo Developer Support
